source.original_plan_why_this_clip: A maned lion lies side-on facing right on a grassy ledge while the camera pans with it and the lion lifts and turns its head toward the camera. The only cut is at 5.0 s; the interval starts at 2.0 s after the second lion that overlaps it at the start has left the frame.
